publication.merge_verification: Actual PR, CI and merge commit are external GitHub facts recorded in the final owner review block; this document does not invent its future merge hash.

methodology.post_close_interval: (broker exit executed_at, min(exit+4h,cutoff)] with cutoff itself excluded
methodology.quotes: Individual recorded liquidation-side updates: bid for long, ask for short, e5 / 100000. Time is local recorder received_at, not exchange event time. No interpolation, OHLC synthesis, new broker history or fabricated prices.
methodology.pip: 10^(-stored broker symbols.pip_position), account-specific symbol ID; BTC/ETH 0.1; oil/silver 0.01. Tick size/price decimals are not substituted for pip size.
methodology.post_close_movement: sign*(quote - actual exit fill); favourable/adverse extrema clamped at zero and divided by pip size or original initial risk-price distance. Positive checkpoint movement is favourable in original direction.
methodology.in_position_excursion: Recorded liquidation-side prices within [entry execution, exit execution], relative to actual entry fill, divided by original risk. Actual broker net R remains separate.
methodology.checkpoints: Last recorded liquidation-side update at or before exit+1h/2h/4h, provided it is <=6 seconds old. Unelapsed or stale endpoints are null, with exact timestamp and age in JSON.
methodology.target_stop_touch: Compare actual quote level with original initial TP/SL; do not compare post-exit R with +1.38R. Touch is an observed path diagnostic, not a fill promise or a strategy that survives its original stop.
methodology.cash: Closing gross profit + swap - absolute closing commission - absolute conversion fee, scaled by close_money_digits. No entry commission observed in this selected ledger; all exits fully close their opening quantities.
methodology.coverage: Elapsed four hours is a clock fact, not continuous market coverage. Extrema are exact over retained quotes and may miss moves between updates; no target hit observed is not a guarantee no unrecorded tick hit.
methodology.history_complete_flag: Recent successful seven-day refreshes deliberately set deal_fetches.complete=false (history.rs recent poll); status=ok, no error and window_from <= audit start < cutoff <= window_to establish coverage for this bounded audit, rather than interpreting that flag as a failed poll.
methodology.snapshots: Cash/equity/book observations are at 04:54–04:55 SGT, health at 04:58:57 SGT, not atomic historical 04:50 marks. The activity ledger and quote analysis remain strictly cut off at 04:50.
